title: Verify Office sees Settings, Staff, and Roles & Permissions in the Settings menu
preconds: Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Office role. (this role has App Settings ON; Service/Parts items follow its sub-toggles). Note: Departments/Locations grouping is under review (SV-7781).
steps:
1. Click the Settings (cog) icon.
  2. Note which items appear in the menu.
  3. Open Staff and Roles & Permissions.
expected: Settings, Staff, and Roles & Permissions are visible and open successfully. Service/Parts items appear only per the role's sub-toggles.
